name: rsi_connors_pullback_v50
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY and BANKNIFTY, sharp 30-60 second micro-selloffs within the prevailing intraday VWAP-trend attract delta-hedging buy flow from option market makers and VWAP-benchmarked institutional algos who are getting fills significantly better than their benchmark. When 1-minute RSI (12 bars at 5s) drops below 20 while spot trades above session VWAP, the selling is counter to the dominant directional order flow — resting bid orders at VWAP-anchored levels absorb the downtick and the index reverts within 30-90 seconds as TWAP algos resume accumulation. The symmetric short fires when RSI(12) spikes above 80 below VWAP as momentum exhaustion invites sell-side VWAP programs to press the move.

indicators.name: rsi_12
indicators.purpose: 12 bars × 5s = 60 seconds — the '1-minute RSI'. Original RSI(2) at 15-min was measuring 30-minute exhaustion with extreme sensitivity. We preserve the extreme-sensitivity spirit: RSI(12) at 5s is still very short (most intraday strategies use RSI(14) at 1-min = 840 bars). At this scale, RSI<20 means the index has dropped nearly every one of the past ~10-12 bars — a genuine micro-exhaustion signal, not noise. Period 12 was chosen because it spans a full 1-minute window, long enough for a real sentiment shift but short enough to trigger before the reversion starts.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset per session_date
indicators.purpose: Replaces SMA(200) as the trend filter. Original SMA(200) at 15-min = 50 hours of data — a multi-day trend filter irrelevant intraday. For intraday NIFTY/BANKNIFTY, VWAP is the universally used benchmark by institutional algos. 'Above VWAP' is the intraday equivalent of a bull trend: TWAP/VWAP algos are net buyers, and any dip below the execution average triggers fresh algorithmic accumulation.

conditions: close > vwap (intraday uptrend — price above VWAP benchmark)
rsi_12 < rsi_oversold (default 20) — extreme 1-minute exhaustion below trend
close < vwap (intraday downtrend — price below VWAP benchmark)
rsi_12 > rsi_overbought (default 80) — extreme 1-minute exhaustion above trend

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 spot pts at delta 0.5. If NIFTY moves 8 spot pts against a 1-minute RSI exhaustion signal within the first few bars, the oversold/overbought reading was insufficient to halt the trend — not a bounce setup but a continuation. NIFTY 30s typical move is 2-5 pts; a stop at 4 pts catches failures before they deepen into 10+ pt losses.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option pts = ~12 spot pts. The expected Connors RSI-2 bounce on NIFTY (RSI snapping back from <20 within a session uptrend) historically covers 10-20 spot points. We capture the lower bound at 1:1.5 R:R, taking profit before the noise-reversion cycle repeats. NIFTY 1-min typical move of 3-7 pts supports this as an achievable target within the 90s hold window.

filters.vix_filter: none — vix not used; VWAP acts as intraday regime filter
filters.time_filter: 09:20-15:25 IST; skip first 5 minutes of pre-open noise
filters.volume_filter: none — index volume is noisy at 5s
filters.trend_filter: VWAP direction as described in entry conditions
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — behavioral. Connors RSI-2 thesis (retail capitulation at exhaustion levels) may weaken as algos become the dominant participant at 5s bars, but VWAP anchoring by institutional algos provides a structural buyer floor that is less behavioral.

adaptation_notes: Three key changes from original: (1) Universe: from nifty200 individual stocks to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index — removes stock-specific noise, improves liquidity, and aligns with institutional VWAP algo flow. (2) Trend filter: SMA(200) at 15-min (50+ hours lookback) replaced by session VWAP — intraday-relevant, reset daily, and directly tracks the benchmark every institutional algo targets. (3) RSI period: RSI(2) at 15-min (30-min exhaustion) scaled to RSI(12) at 5s (60-second exhaustion) — preserves extreme sensitivity without being pure noise. Original exit (close > SMA(5)) replaced by fixed point target because option premium dynamics differ from equity price dynamics; a time stop of 18 bars (90s) prevents holding through directional reversals.
weaknesses: RSI(12) on NIFTY at 5s can fire many false signals during strong trending sessions — VWAP filter alone may not be sufficient
Opening 5 minutes excluded but first 30-60 minutes often have high volatility that increases false oversold/overbought readings
On expiry days, option premiums decay rapidly — profitable spot direction may not translate to option premium gains within 90s
VWAP drifts in trending days; buying above VWAP may still be in a late-day downtrend
